mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of declining FEDFUNDS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points over a 3-month period signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precede negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the UNRATE rise condition, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales exceeding 0.5% over a 3-month period indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer and business demand, which is followed by negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline > 0.5% in 3 months, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%), a 0.25 percentage point increase in the federal funds rate within one month signals aggressive monetary tightening, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%), 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 1 month (t-test p > 0.05), or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production over the past 3 months reflects robust economic activity, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of rising INDPRO are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts figure below 1400 thousand units signals a contraction in the housing market, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls below 1400.0 (thousands of units) in the latest month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST falls below 1400.0, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weak employment growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.1% over 3 months) and rising unemployment (UNRATE increase > 0.2pp) indicate a deteriorating labor market, which is followed by negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth < 0.1% and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth < 0.1% and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (GDPC1 growth > 2.5% for 3 consecutive quarters), a quarterly GDP growth rate below 2.0% signals an economic slowdown, which is followed by negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate < 2.0% in the latest quarter
regime_hint: late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth > 2.5% for 3 consecutive quarters)
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regimes, 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 growth rate < 2.0% in the latest quarter (t-test p > 0.05), or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
